# Harrison

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Emily](../character/emily.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man who typically presents a neat and snug appearance. He has a round face and prominent blue eyes, which bulge significantly when he is overcome with rage.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Considered an odd person and a crank by others, Mr. Harrison describes himself as a crusty, lonesome, and outspoken man who tends to state the plain truth. Despite his rough demeanour, he is genuinely kind, outwardly sympathetic, and deeply empathic toward animals.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P20](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0020), +1 more_

## History

Before moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mr. Harrison lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), rarely spoke, and had visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy. At the request of his dying sister, he married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott and took a two-week wedding trip to St. John, though he later separated from her over domestic habits and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), which he had received from his dying brother. After settling in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he angrily confronted his neighbor [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when her cow strayed into his field, but the pair soon became friends after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold his cow, confessed, and traded her own cow to make amends. Harrison later refused to donate to the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and scoffed at Anne's ideals regarding school discipline. After a severe hailstorm hit [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and killed [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), Harrison's wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), leading to a reconciliation between the couple.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), +28 more_

## Quotes

> "Sorry, miss! Sorry isn’t going to help matters any. You’d better go and look at the havoc that animal has made in my oats . . . trampled them from center to circumference, miss."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> "He’s . . . he’s always talking nonsense. I got him from my brother who was a sailor. Sailors don’t always use the choicest language, and parrots are very imitative birds."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)

> "has she gone and broken into my oats again? Well, never mind . . . never mind if she has. It’s no difference . . . none at all, I . . . I was too hasty yesterday, that’s a fact. Never mind if she has."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are neighbors who become good friends and converse regularly. Their acquaintance begins on a hostile note when Harrison confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over her cow straying into his oat field, which leads to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally selling Harrison's cow by mistake. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits him to confess, offer a trade, and apologize, Harrison forgives her, invites her for tea, and establishes a warm friendship. Though Harrison occasionally scoffs at her ideals—such as her refusal to use corporal punishment or her canvassing efforts—they remain close companions who frequently discuss community matters and neighbors.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), +24 more_

- Friend of — good friends and neighbours who converse regularly  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is Harrison's wife, who unexpectedly arrives in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reunite with him. The couple had previously separated due to conflicts over domestic habits and Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). After her arrival, they reconcile their marriage, clean their home, and host [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for tea.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), +8 more_

- Spouse of — married  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0004)</sub>
